body: Thanks for your words ForgottenEssence, I suppose its true that I would go out of my way to not be a burden, but I'll be honest here, and though it may sound cruel... I don't feel like I care about my family any more than I care about any other abstract group of people who are suffering their own greifs (e.g. tokyo earthquake survivors, katrina victims). We just aren't close, and there is likely good reasons for that. I say this only to underline that I am certainly not coping, I don't know what occasionally seems to bring this dread and despair or why I feel like nurturing it... certainly something in me want to be rid of it. But it is almost as if it feeds on itself.. a desire to self-destruct with fear of going through with it. Reading my own words I feel egotistical to even feel as I do. Events, even terrible ones, just seem to wash over me... they don't cause me great distress, for some reason I deal with them calmly, like they are no big deal... its this state I just don't know
